system.description: Hasikians are a Species responsible for many great works of art and literature, perhaps a result of the deep emotions they feel, and the rapidness with which they change emotional states. After one too many spacers tried asking for directions and ended up getting any number of emotional outbursts as a result, it became a running joke that the reason the scales on a Hasikian's head change color is to help outsiders keep track of when it's safe to approach them.
